normalization: Only Markdown table delimiter spacing/dash lengths, unordered bullet dash/star cosmetics, angle brackets around unchanged HTTP(S) URL destinations and escaped literal code_source/evidence_artifact label brackets outside literal code, terminal newlines. Parser-generated autolinks are never normalized away; actual identical-literal repairs require separate evidence.
omitted_fields: Assignee/cycle not requested or certified; do not infer absent fields as backend null.
